prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [sign_in, hint] Account pet persistence reassurance hint: Displays a clear sign-in hint promising that signing in saves your current pet and links existing pets safely.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in secures your companion and syncs any previously created pets automatically."}}
1: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption summary review screen: Adds a new pet adoption summary screen right before the adoption certificate to confirm pet details and photo setup.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_step_counter": true}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_summary", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop pet launch wait timer update: Displays an accurate time estimate and hint on the waiting screen while the desktop pet asset generates in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your desktop companion is building. This usually takes around 2 minutes."}}
3: [finish, new_flow] Pet interactive control quick guide sub-flow: Introduces a new interactive pet control onboarding sub-flow after the home intro to demonstrate how to summon, hide, and interact with the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"button_label": "Learn Quick Controls"}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_pet_quick_controls"]}
4: [choose_path, reorder] Sign-in placement after companion selection: Moves sign-in immediately after pick_friend so users authenticate right after choosing their pet companion before photo upload.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "sign_in", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
5: [finish, redesign] Checklist layout redesign for home welcome screen: Redesigns the final home intro screen using a checklist layout highlighting essential pet shortcut commands and visibility toggles.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "checklist", "headline": "Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "body": "Follow these quick tips to summon, hide, or talk with your pet anytime on your desktop."}}
6: [choose_path, hint] Path selection duration guidance hint: Adds a short contextual hint on the choose_path screen explaining that path selection takes under 10 seconds.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Choose your path to begin—takes less than 10 seconds to set up."}}
7: [adoption, copy] Photo format guidance and upload tips copy: Updates copy on the photo upload screen with clear guidelines on photo angle and lighting for custom pet creation.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload a Clear Photo for Best Pet Results", "body": "Use a well-lit, front-facing image. Avoid heavy filters or covered faces for accurate pet creation.", "hint": "Supported formats: JPG, PNG. Max file size: 10MB."}}
8: [home, notification] Desktop ready status notification prompt: Enables readiness notification alerts on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while pet generation completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to switch windows. We will notify you on desktop when your pet is ready!"}}
9: [choose_path, new_screen] Companion mode orientation screen: Adds a companion mode intro screen after the story screen to explain active vs background pet behavior options before choosing a path.
   config: {"choose_path": {"show_step_counter": true}, "_order": ["story", "new_companion_mode_intro", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
